BiblicalUsage: David and all Israel played before God with cymbals and trumpets, and the Levites stood at the east end of the altar with cymbals and psalteries and harps while a hundred and twenty priests sounded with trumpets. The word is the cymbal itself, always in pairs, always in worship.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the cymbals belong where David put them: before God, with all their might, in the worship of the people He had chosen.
